correctness.rationale: The m square binomials give the ladder edge ideal. Independently, reduce monomials by u_i w_i=v_{i-1}v_i so that no monomial uses both rails of one square. Substituting w_i=v_{i-1}v_i/u_i sends distinct reduced monomials to distinct Laurent monomials: each u_i exponent recovers the rail pair and then the v exponents recover the remaining rung factors. The rung and top-rail edge monomials are algebraically independent by leaf elimination on their spanning tree. This verifies the prime complete intersection and projective dimension 2m. In a Jacobian dependence each participating nonzero row has both rails zero by its private rail columns; its equation and nonzero row force exactly one nonzero rung and a single supported column. Cancellation then requires an adjacent pair supported in the same rung column. The remaining case is a zero row, where each neighbor has one vanishing rail. Thus the maximal pieces are precisely the row-zero loci after the neighbor rail choices and the adjacent-row loci. Their residual square equations lie in disjoint smaller ladder blocks with independent free variables; each list member is irreducible and has its full complementary coordinate support (all ones there is a point). The ambient codimension is always m+3; there are four end-row pieces and m-1 adjacent-row pieces of degree 2^(m-2), and 4(m-2) interior-row pieces of degree 2^(m-3), by complete-intersection degrees. Independent analytic elimination solves the other equations using unit rails, or in the adjacent-row case first eliminates the shared rung using a unit rung. The only transverse equation is a rank-four quadric, up to a unit rescaling. A separate finite-field support and Jacobian replay for m=3,4,5 corroborated component counts 10,15,20 and degree totals 16,44,112; it is not used as the proof over C.
residual_risks: The degree is of the reduced equidimensional union in the stated embedding; the proof does not give the degree or multiplicities of the Jacobian scheme. The node description holds on a dense open part of each component only.

evidence: Wagner tests contracted-poset fibers for being trees. Lakshmibai–Mukherjee give a union of Hibi orbit closures by a general singularity test. Brown–Lakshmibai give purity in codimension three and a generic quadric cone when the join-irreducible poset is a grid lattice.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The first two criteria apply in the Hibi model above. The third is close in conclusion, but the join-irreducible poset here is the ordinal sum of antichains, not a lattice: each same-layer incomparable pair has no join (two incomparable minimal upper bounds or none at the last layer). The grid-lattice theorem does not apply to this model.

evidence: In the ideal lattice of m successive two-element antichains, the only incomparable pairs are the two rails of each diamond. Their meet and join are the two successive rungs. This identifies the graded Hibi coordinate ring with the graph edge coordinate ring. One-sided ladder determinantal varieties have a related component theorem, but an identical instance was not established.

originality.rationale: Credit the established ladder edge-ring complete intersection and the applicable general Hibi singularity theory. Indeed the same projective embedding is Hibi: use the lattice of ideals of the ordinal sum of m two-element antichains, with the rung coordinates the ends of successive diamonds and the two rails their incomparable elements. The Hibi straightening relations are exactly the square quadrics. Thus general Hibi criteria already cover qualitative singular support. The supported distinct contribution is the explicit degree profile for this family, requiring the exhaustive component calculation and the residual-chain degree count, not a first criterion for where toric singularities occur.
residual_risks: An earlier worked specialization under Hibi, order-polytope or ladder determinantal terminology could include the degree formula. The 2000 ladder determinantal follow-up was not retrievable in bounded OA attempts. Neither this gap nor a related search hit establishes coverage.

The calculation exhibits two different degree levels despite equal codimension and generic transverse type, and provides an exact whole-family answer rather than a single instance or an evaluation of smoothness alone.
